The final mathematical review passed and all three classical source leaves were verified and attested, but D0.5 assessed subfield novelty (score ceiling 6.7 versus field threshold 7.4), independently confirmed as a terminal downgrade. tldr: For this fixed-population one-third-quota design, exact linear block balance causes a nonlinear curvature drift in ordinary difference in means. The public coefficient engine gives its exact coefficient and a uniform second-order expansion. The primitive exact-slice limit and observed conservative studentizer yield the sharp ranges \(K=o(\sqrt n)\) for ordinary DIM and \(K=o(n^{3/4})\) for the stipulated FIRST correction, with shifted-normal laws and a legal boundary witness. As a corollary, exact \(b(K,m)\) calibration removes deterministic curvature drift up to observed-cell estimation and zero fallback, giving uniform conservative root-\(n\) inference when \(m/\log n\to\infty\), strictly beyond the first-correction frontier. These are results for three specified centers, not all-estimator optimality claims.
